name: tts-cpp
description: THROWAWAY CI OVERLAY - do not merge. The published tts-cpp port with REF repointed to the unmerged cosyvoice-opencl branch (PR #118), which runs CosyVoice3 end-to-end on GPU. Pairs with the ggml-speech overlay beside it, which lets the Adreno fused IM2COL->GEMM path take an unaligned M. NOTE: the tts-ggml addon exposes no CosyVoice engine (EngineType is Chatterbox / Supertonic / Parler), so a CI run against this overlay exercises the changed Adreno OpenCL kernels through the shipping engines -- it does not run CosyVoice itself. Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts).
